payload.title: Per-record authz + grants on object subscriptions/snapshots
payload.description:
Object SUBSCRIPTIONS (objects(type)) and their snapshots/deltas are NOT authorized per-record: the gateway delivers all tenant rows of a type to any subscriber, never calling decide()/relaxWithGrants per object. So an app cannot do per-record read visibility (e.g. a customer seeing ONLY their own Vessels/WorkOrders/Invoices) over live sync — a tightening-only policy hook that denies object.read would just break the whole subscription (or be ignored), and the grant mechanism (store.grants.create + relaxWithGrants) only applies to individual reads.

WORK: in the sync delivery path (the object snapshot-on-subscribe + the live object-delta fan-out — NOT in apps/server/src/sync/gateway.ts where the object path doesn't live; find the object subscription delivery), filter each object row per subscriber by the same decide()+relaxWithGrants used for HTTP object reads, so denied rows are omitted from the snapshot and never fanned out. Tenant scoping already applies; this adds the per-record layer. Likely needs the principal on the connection (already present) + a per-object decide call.

ACCEPTANCE: with a policy hook denying object.read for a role + grants issued on that principal's own records, a subscriber receives ONLY granted rows in the initial snapshot AND in live deltas; other roles unaffected; pnpm test/typecheck/verify:generated green.

FOUND VIA aquarius-os AQ-63 (per-record customer portal visibility). Sibling of FR-109 (projection push) / FR-114 (server-originated push) — the 'authorize the sync read path' gap.
